basis: Apps/ble_scanner.c:155-163 calls stop before shared-text begin. portable_radio_suspend:76-95 closes token and releases grant before progression; uncertain custody retries cleanup only.

System text_input_policy.inc preserves background/capture progression, defers mutable-frame and busy-input policy, and prevents continuity-only battery checks from escalating into sleep.

policy-resume-again and policy-resume-retained assert one policy sample and no repeated dispatch; sleep-error/sleep-retained freeze resources after one sleep attempt.
Runtime-loss fixtures assert silent retention, unchanged grants/subscriptions/frames and no subsequent Runtime/provider I/O.

basis: Both the real host fixture and unchanged selected ui-scene manifest contain exactly display.output, input.touch.raw, platform.clock and ui.presentation-profile.
Independent command normalization shows only -DPORTABLE_TEXT_INPUT_POLICY is added; original four font inputs, features, imports, exports and grants are preserved.
Flag-off artifact is byte-for-byte equal to the selected 0.2.18 ELF and the unchanged-app/current-dependency reference.
Independent stack-inspection rerun reproduces the bound record exactly: max modal entry frame 448 bytes, bounded static editor/client/checkpoint state.
Independent struct-based ELF32 parser compared all section inventory/order/contents and section semantics, exact SHF_ALLOC headers/content, symbol and relocation tables and raw program-header table.
All three inputs change only absolute bytes 32 and 33 inside ELF32 e_shoff (field range 32..35) within the first PT_LOAD. All other bytes of every segment remain exact.
Only Model Viewer and Calculator are packing-only companions; their selected original artifact and source receipts are exact.
Independent in-memory reconstruction has exactly five changed paths, 113 files and 55 ELFs, with all other 52 ELFs and boot authority bytes exact.
Independent page calculation is 19,158 data plus 248 index pages = 19,406 object pages, four pages below the unchanged two-block floor. No additional JSON compaction.
Existing exact-cohort normal and ASan/UBSan admission receipts are byte-identical, bind the reconstructed candidate digest and report zero hardware/storage calls.

limitations: The prior 76 Scanner workflows were independently source/log/frame-verified; this reviewer freshly reran all 15 policy cases normal and ASan/UBSan (30 runs), all companion host gates (36 runs), 30+6 unit tests and the static target-stack inspector.
Normal/sanitized exact-target cohort admission results were receipt-verified separately from source behavior, not claimed as Xtensa execution.
Model Viewer uses the exact receipt-matching RiscFileOpenSourceV1.h; it differs from the historical Runtime workflow pin only by four contract-comment lines and produces identical preprocessed bytes.
ASan and UBSan remained enabled; LeakSanitizer was disabled for the verified ptrace environment limitation.
e_shoff changes inside the first PT_LOAD; do not describe every raw load-segment byte as unchanged.
448-byte maximum measured modal entry frame is not proof of peak dynamic call-chain stack use.
This review gives no physical hardware, flash, delivery, X4 Scanner or RF 0.3.5 qualification.
